Increases Class Ability Regeneration Rate while 3 enemies are within 15 meters:
250%|666%|1085%|1500% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate with 3|4|5|6+ enemies

1 second after casting a Rift:
The Rift releases an <arc/>Arc Shockwave that deals <pve 400 /> <pvp [100] /> damage and knocks back enemies in a 7.5 meter radius. Additional <arc/>Arc Shockwaves are released every 5 seconds.

Enemies killed by Shockwaves explode, dealing up to <pve 200 /> <pvp [100?] /> <arc/>Arc damage.

While you have an <arc/>Arc Super equipped, Shockwaves and explosions <arc/>Blind nearby targets.
